The frozen facts-counted-g10017 policy retains its earlier V100 acceptance at source 6c6633220b67faffa0f01a5fa5c4f7a556a97f0b. Facts joint training and the 200-game paired system comparison completed in V100 job 2348998 at source b7813532640e5238e64b49a5c47e9dc9219feda6 with q12.v2 constraints; both GPU acceptance gates and 34 GPU tests passed. The final archive and 4212 recovered artifacts passed lineage, SHA and match-statistics audit. Other historical GPU evidence is referenced, not rerun. The new comparison does not establish a strength improvement or isolate the contribution of BeliefNet from search. Current repository cleanup is not relabeled as historical training source. On 2026-10-04 four matched joint/marginal belief models from two seeds were recovered after V100 preparation job 2349370 (COMPLETED, exit 0:0; 2630 seconds) at frozen source c2580f272f8edb59db3c7b7ac841608c20fe383f. The preparation-only audit verified 4864 artifacts, 86 GPU tests with zero skips, both exact GPU training-resume acceptances, four selected/resume/test lineages, and the complete post-build source digest including nine generated CMake files. The planned 1200 formal match games remain in progress at registration; no new formal win rate is registered, and facts-counted-g10017 remains the default.
